headline: Strategic Bases Shift Across Fronts as Fighting Intensifies
war_summary: On day 245 the war remains deadlocked with no victor, but the latest three‑hour window shows a surge of ownership changes on several fronts. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest sector, adding roughly 1,184 Colonial and 1,648 Warden casualties in the last two hours and recording eleven base flips, raising its daily total to twenty‑eight. Godcrofts continues its relentless churn, logging one new flip in the past two hours for a running total of seventy‑three. DeadLands reported three fresh flips and a spike of 1,037 Warden casualties in the same period. Linn Mercy saw three additional flips and sharp rises in both factions' losses, while Marban Hollow recorded three flips for the first time today. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle, though quiet in the last two hours, each logged multiple flips over the prior six hours (nine and five respectively). Farranac Coast, Mooring County and Callahan's Passage showed no new two‑hour activity but retain elevated six‑hour flip counts. Enlistments are climbing sharply on the most active fronts, especially Weathered Expanse (+68) and Linn Mercy (+116). All other regions reported no base transitions in the last two hours.
